evidence.observed: Official site requires a floral-business resale license, supplies fresh flowers and floral supplies, and identifies Phoenix and Houston wholesale locations.

observations.claim_summary: H&T's official site lists B2B wholesale operations in Phoenix, Arizona and Houston, Texas.
Buzzfile estimates $4,620,075 annual revenue and 19 employees at the Phoenix location; this is a third-party location-level estimate, not audited financials.
Dun & Bradstreet's Arizona wholesaler directory lists H&T Wholesale Flowers, Inc. at $5.16M sales revenue; the result does not state whether it includes the Houston location.
